title: 2 Beautiful Homes in Nashville (Sleeps 20)
description:
Enjoy your time in The Music City in our two side-by-side modern luxury homes with your group of friends or family. Just moments from downtown, these homes are the perfect place to get ready for your night out on Broadway, or to relax as a group while using our ample open-space social area and fully equipped kitchen. We have generous sleeping arrangements or cozy up on the couch to watch your favorite show. Our homes are a short 7 minute Uber ride to downtown! Yes, you're booking two homes!
